paper_id: Dong et al. - 2009 - Fine-grained boundary recognition in wireless ad hoc and sensor networks by topological methods
title: Fine-grained boundary recognition in wireless ad hoc and sensor networks by topological methods
motivation: 现有方法无法检测小洞,而网络实际中存在大量由节点失效形成的小空洞
problem_framing: 在无位置信息条件下,如何精确定位任意大小的网络边界洞
key_insight: 边界环不能用三角形填充,通过FGP变换保持基本群同时收缩图结构

evaluation_criteria: 能否检测任意大小的洞,特别是小洞,与WGM等先进方法对比
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 现有方法在小洞密集时难以区分,WGM的割支会合并连通

cut branches will be combined and connected together
